findings.claim: The --full path drops the disposable database WITH (force), which terminates any client session that connects between the preparer's zero-client check (prepare-rait-priority-v1-baseline.mjs restoreFreshPriorityV3Database, lines 383-391) and the drop, so that window kills sessions instead of failing closed; by contrast the preparer's own createDedicatedDatabase path uses a plain DROP DATABASE that fails if sessions exist.
findings.fix: Remove WITH (force) from the --full drop so a concurrent session makes the drop fail (fail closed, like createDedicatedDatabase), or re-verify count(*)=0 client backends for the target datname inside apply.sh immediately before the DROP within the same admin session.

findings.claim: The draft/decision constraint reconciliation accepts any pre-existing definition that merely contains substrings via LIKE ('%document_id%' here; '%signature_kind%'/'%signature_ref%' at lines 125-127 and '%circuit%'/'%PAdES-TSA%' at lines 133-135), so a drifted legacy variant that mentions the tokens but enforces a weaker predicate would be silently accepted instead of failing closed; this is exact only against the pinned v1.1.0 snapshots, and is weaker than the FK guards which compare full pg_get_constraintdef equality (lines 45 and 96).
findings.fix: Compare the full pg_get_constraintdef(oid) text against the exact expected historical definition (replace) and the exact target definition (accept), raising 'Unknown ... check' for any other text, mirroring the exact-equality pattern already used for the two agency_jurisdiction foreign keys.

findings.claim: structuralCatalog restricts the fresh-vs-upgrade constraint comparison to the four priority tables, so the permanent divergence the pre script itself creates — ck_inf_rait_draft_submitted_required, ck_inf_rait_decision_signature_pair and ck_inf_rait_decision_circuit_one_signature are NOT VALID on an upgraded database but VALID on a fresh one — is outside the compared surface and never surfaced or asserted anywhere.
findings.fix: Extend the constraints filter to include inf.rait_draft and inf.rait_decision, normalizing or explicitly asserting the expected 'NOT VALID' suffix difference between fresh and upgraded schemas, or record the accepted divergence nominally in CTG-0001-C4-OD.md so the equivalence claim is scoped in the contract rather than only in a test comment.
